_comment_DO_NOT_REMOVE: Contract A (op-wiring) fixture — UX-V2-ARCHITECTURE.md §2 (A.1 'Adding an op — the end-to-end checklist'). The guardian for R3/2dk: a new op that is not wired through EVERY layer it needs is silently half-built. Each row declares the layers a given op MUST appear in; cf/test/conformance-contract-v2.sh greps each declared layer and FAILS if one is missing. Seeded with the EXISTING wired ops as the passing baseline; each v2 track flips its 'planned' row to 'wired' (and corrects the proxy/migration paths to what it actually shipped) when it lands. Layer fields: module = cf/src/<concern>.js whose *_OPS Set lists the op (null for a substrate-switch op handled directly in coordinator.js); ops_set = that Set's name (null for substrate); guard = the coordinator.js dispatch (a Set name => grep '<SET>.has'; 'substrate' => grep 'case "<op>"'); proxy = web/functions/api/<area>/<name>.js that hard-codes the op (null for a daemon-emitted/internal op with no web surface); adapter = true if cf/pages-dev/adapter.js maps it (grep 'op === "<op>"'); migration = cf/migrations/NNNN_<name>.sql that must exist if the op added a table (null otherwise).
